verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms a Neural Engine exists and is used for on-device AI, and Apple ships real developer SDKs/runtimes today (Core ML, MLX, Metal Performance Shaders, PyTorch backend support) — apple-m4-pro-docs-5,9,10,11,20. However, no published TOPS figure or stated precision for the Neural Engine appears anywhere in the evidence pack, which is a core requirement of the story. Missing for 10: an explicit TOPS number, precision specification (e.g., INT8/FP16), and any independent benchmark corroborating NPU throughput.
